newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Air NZ shareholders approve Ansett buy-in.
newsitem.headline: Air NZ shareholders approve Ansett buy-in.

text.p: Air New Zealand Ltd shareholders, voting at an extraordinary general meeting, on Friday approved the proposed purchase of half of Ansett Australia from TNT Ltd.
Air NZ is investing a total A$475 million to buy into Ansett, using a cash issue, new borrowings and existing cash reserves.
The deal includes a capital injection of A$150 million by Air NZ to Ansett. News Ltd, which owns the other half of Ansett, will inject A$50 million.

The Australian government gave the green light for the deal earlier this month, but stipulated Air NZ should not be allowed to take 50 percent of Ansett's international operations. These will be 51 percent owned by an Australian holding company, Holdco, and 49 percent by Ansett.
